title: status_polling allowed exactly the 15 s the environment poll plus a silent reply take, so it failed whenever the poll came late
description:
test_focuser_primaluce_simulator status_polling waits 15 s for FOCUSER_TEMPERATURE ALERT after arming a silent EXT_T reply. The environment is polled every 10 s and a silent reply costs the 5 s serial read timeout, so the ALERT arrives up to 15 s later. On Linux it failed 2 of 3 isolated reruns and in all three full baseline runs.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000050.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
